data.title: Watch these spaces
data.description: Around 50 participating brands emanate the dynamism of the watch industry at the inaugural Time & Treasures organised by Central Chidlom and Central Embassy.

data.title: Ancient, modern combine in limited editions
data.description: Showcased at the Time & Treasures event, two commemorative timepieces epitomise Japanese aesthetic and microengineering. The limited editions illustrate how ancestral techniques and modern technology can equally convey artistic expressions on the dial.

data.title: Kieran opts out of squad for LA push
data.description: Thai-American distance runner Kieran Tuntivate has spoken of his regret at missing the 20th Asian Games in Japan, revealing he turned down a place in Thailand's athletics squad to focus on his marathon ambitions instead.

data.title: Musk threatens legal action over documentary
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - Elon Musk's lawyers put the makers of a new four-hour documentary about the multibillionaire on formal legal notice days before its premiere, warning that the film defames him.

data.title: Tilapia exports face scrutiny
data.description: A civil society group has called for a traceability investigation into the import and export of blackchin tilapia, citing data showing more than 320,000 fish were exported before the species was reported to have spread in Thailand.

data.title: Tremor recorded as Israel says Hezbollah tunnels destroyed in south Lebanon
data.description: JERUSALEM - Israel said Thursday it demolished key tunnels built by the Iran-backed Hezbollah group beneath the strategic Ali al-Taher ridge in southern Lebanon, triggering a 4.1 magnitude tremor.

data.title: Man United, Bayern cruise as Como make dream Champions League start
data.description: PARIS - Manchester United celebrated their return to the Champions League with a 4-0 thrashing of Sabah on Thursday, as Cesc Fabregas's Como impressed on their debut in Europe's premier club competition.

data.title: Thai Airways drug case nears detention deadline
data.description: Prosecutors have ordered the urgent conclusion of an investigation into a transnational drug network linked to a Thai Airways flight attendant, setting Sept 14 as the deadline to prevent three detained suspects from being released.

data.title: First meeting set to hasten conciliation
data.description: Thailand is ready for the first conciliation meeting with Cambodia, scheduled in Singapore from Monday to Wednesday.

data.title: Cloud tech spurs real-life concerns
data.description: Thailand is seeking to capitalise on investment relocating from the United States and China amid geopolitical tensions, but the rapid expansion of data-centre infrastructure has raised concerns over its impact on energy security, electricity and water demand.

data.description: Pheu Thai Party leader and Labour Minister Julapun Amornvivat has dismissed reports of a secret political deal between the Bhumjaithai (BJT) and Klatham parties.

data.title: Klong Toey oil leak downplayed as 'minor issue'
data.description: Deputy Prime Minister and Transport Minister Phiphat Ratchakitprakarn has sought to reassure residents that oil contamination in Bangkok's Klong Toey district was caused by seepage from a pipeline rather than a major leak. He said engineers should be able to seal the affected section.

data.title: Pit bull kills second owner
data.description: A pit bull mauled its 70-year-old owner to death at a rented house in Bangkok on Wednesday, police said.

data.title: King, Queen poised for Vietnam visit
data.description: Their Majesties the King and Queen will visit Vietnam from Sept 14 to 16 to mark the 50th anniversary of diplomatic relations between the two countries.

data.title: PET water bottles 'safe' to drink from, FDA assures
data.description: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has confirmed that PET bottled water is safe to drink despite online claims that bottles stored in cars or left in the sun can cause cancer.

data.title: Suchai upbeat despite uphill trek in Japan
data.description: Tennis chief Suchai Pornchaisakudom believes that the Asian Games competition will be challenging but remains confident that Thai athletes can pull off a strong showing in Aichi-Nagoya.

data.title: ARL to keep  operating amid talks
data.description: State Railway of Thailand (SRT) governor Anan Phonimdaeng has assured passengers that the Airport Rail Link will continue operating despite ongoing talks with its concessionaire, Asia Era One Co, a subsidiary of CP Group.

data.title: Thunder Castle begin life under Silva
data.description: Defending champions Buriram United return to Thai League 1 action today, hosting Chiang Rai United at the Chang Arena in new head coach Mario Silva's first match in charge since his appointment this week.

data.title: Govt may extend stimulus
data.description: The government says it will consider extending the Thais Help Thais Plus stimulus programme by the end of this month, noting that if the Middle East energy crisis persists, further measures to ease the cost of living may be needed.

data.title: Carney says in touch with Trump, Canada ready for 'fair' trade deal
data.description: CALGARY (CANADA) - Prime Minister Mark Carney said Thursday that he had spoken to US President Donald Trump "in recent days" and Ottawa remains ready to reach a "fair" trade deal with Washington, despite escalating economic tensions.

data.title: Canada pledges support for Ukraine air defense as Zelensky visits
data.description: CALGARY (CANADA) - Canada offered support Thursday to boost Ukraine's air defenses and help replenish its drone stocks, as the countries pledged to deepen their alliance during a visit by President Volodymyr Zelensky.

data.title: Morocco says not involved in Ceuta migrant influx
data.description: RABAT - Morocco said on Thursday there were "no facts" establishing its involvement in the massive migrant rush into Spain's North African exclave of Ceuta in July.

data.title: Latin America could see fresh disinformation after Meta changes
data.description: MONTEVIDEO - As Meta moves to scrap fact-checking for Facebook and Instagram posts across Latin America, experts predict the change will lead to sharply degraded public debate in the region.

data.title: Russian strike on Ukraine shopping centre kills at least six
data.description: KYIV (UKRAINE) - At least five people were killed and nearly 70 others wounded on Thursday when a Russian strike hit a shopping centre in Pavlograd, central Ukraine, the authorities announced.

data.title: NGO chief sees 'hypocrisy' in Afghan women's rights calls amid aid cuts
data.description: KABUL - The head of the Norwegian Refugee Council aid group, Jan Egeland, criticised on Thursday what he called the "hypocrisy" of countries demanding rights for Afghan women while cutting humanitarian assistance.

data.title: Sati Store: The Mobile Cart Bringing Dhamma to City Streets
data.description: Chulalongkorn University and Suan Mokkh Bangkok introduce "Sati Store", a mobile cart blending creative design with everyday Buddhist philosophy

data.title: In their words: Israeli forces describe AI-backed Gaza killing in new film
data.description: VENICE - A new documentary from two Oscar-winning Israeli filmmakers provides damning new testimony about AI-enabled mass killings in Gaza from the men and women who took part, the directors told AFP on Thursday ahead of its premiere in Venice.

data.title: Thai artists performing in China in celebration of ties
data.description: Around 100 Thai artists and musicians have travelled to perform at the Beijing International Great Wall Concert 2026, taking place Sep 10-11 , marking 51 years of diplomatic relations between the two countries.

data.title: Yemen's Houthis seize key city on Red Sea: military source
data.description: SANAA - Yemen's Houthis seized control of the strategic Red Sea port city of Mokha on Thursday, a Yemeni military source told AFP, as the Iran-backed group reported fresh strikes by Saudi forces.

data.title: Analysts say Israel's right could exploit sanctions in run-up to vote
data.description: JERUSALEM - British-led sanctions over settlement expansion in the West Bank may have the unintended effect of emboldening the Israeli right ahead of elections, analysts and a diplomatic source told AFP.

data.title: Vance takes spotlight as Republicans close Trump-heavy convention
data.description: DALLAS (UNITED STATES) - US Republicans returned to the stage Thursday to close their midterm convention, still betting that Donald Trump's political magnetism can overcome grim election forecasts -- while giving Vice President JD Vance a prime-time showcase as a potential heir.

data.title: Siam Piwat and WFP Partner to Deliver 100,000 Meals for Food Security
data.description: Because every meal has the power to create a meaningfuldifference andimpact, Siam Piwat Group has joined hands with the United Nations World FoodProgramme(WFP) to launch “The Next Bucket: Save Lives & Change Lives”.Theinitiative invites everyone to share the power of giving through food, supporting WFP’s mission toassistpeopleand communities affected by crises and food insecurity across Asiaand thePacific.
